\section{Method}
We use the three-dimensional PIC code EMSES \cite{Miyake2009}.
The grid spacing is set to $\Delta x = 0.5\lambda_D$, where $\lambda_D$ is the Debye length.
The solar wind flows at 400 km/s with a density of 5 cm$^{-3}$.
The photoelectron current density is given by
\begin{equation}
J_{ph} = J_{ph0} \cos\theta ,
\label{eq:jph}
\end{equation}
where $\theta$ is the solar zenith angle.
